Remove stored credentials for a registry.

Deletes the authentication token from the local credentials file.

# Example

```bash largo logout ```

Usage: largo logout [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --registry <REGISTRY>
          Registry URL. Defaults to `registry.logicaffeine.com`

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo logout
  largo logout --registry https://registry.example.com
